chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from a man, from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a one-eyed man who deliberately put out the eye of a sound man. He said: “His eye shall be put out.” I said: Then he would become blind. He said: “The right has made him blind.”

key_terms.اَلْحَقُّ: the right; the just legal claim
key_terms.تُفْقَأُ: it is put out; legally subjected to retributive injury
key_terms.صَحِيحٍ: a person physically sound in this context, with intact eyesight

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a one-eyed man deliberately puts out the eye of a person with sound eyesight?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling in qisas regarding a one-eyed man who intentionally destroys the eye of a person with two sound eyes. The Imam عليه السلام states that retributive justice is carried out by putting out his remaining eye, even if this results in total blindness, because the right of justice necessitates it.
